meta.title: Simone Guarneri, short-term rentals and software
meta.description: I manage short-term rentals in Campania, Italy, and build the software and automations that run them.

heroA: I manage short-term rentals in Italy
heroB: and build the software and automations that run them.
heroMeta: {age}. Self-taught developer: I have studied computer science since I was 16 and have worked in hospitality since 21, when I opened my first Airbnb listing. I speak Italian and English. Based in Campania, open to relocating.

what.title: Property management
what.body: Full management, or only the part you need: pricing, listing setup and copy, or advice on a new property. Owners get clear monthly reports.

what.title: Technology and automation
what.body: I build software and automations for my homes and for other hosts, connected to the channel managers they already use. Less manual work, fewer errors.

what.title: Growth and strategy
what.body: I assess new properties and markets with real numbers: rates, occupancy, costs. If a deal does not work on paper, I say so.

workIntro: One brand I co-founded and one network I work with.
dorotea: Nine homes on the Amalfi Coast, in Salerno and in Milan. Built from scratch in 2023 with Tommaso Apicella.
quattro: A network of more than 50 homes around Vietri sul Mare and Baronissi. I work with them and manage three of the homes.
buildIntro: Software I write alongside the rentals. Used every day in my own homes first.

build.title: Casabase
build.body: A layer on top of channel managers that optimizes and extends them. In daily internal use at Dorotea Housing.

build.title: Casadata
build.body: A data aggregator for short-term rental research. Market data from several sources in one place, so research is faster and leaner.

build.title: AI tools
build.body: Claude Code skills and AI tools for short-term rentals: market research, listing writing and pricing analysis.

skillsIntro: What I use every day, across homes and code.

ai.label: AI
ai.note: I use it with method to strengthen human work, not replace it: I decide, review and answer for every line.

how.title: Numbers first.
how.body: Every decision starts from data. Opinions come after.

how.title: Build what is missing.
how.body: If a tool does not exist or does not fit, I write it.

how.title: Say it plainly.
how.body: Owners hear the good news and the bad news, early.

how.title: Grow when ready.
how.body: A new property comes on only when the operation can carry it.

contactBody: Own a property, have a project, or want to work together? Write to me directly. I read every message.
